transport: exact-key JSON reference values; not executable section admission

exact_fields.bits: exact ceil(width/8) little-endian bytes as lowercase hex; high padding zero
exact_fields.poison: same-width bit mask,1 marks poison; no whole-word collapse until typed scalar bitcast
exact_fields.pointers: list <=1024, unique identity, exact fields identity:256-bit lowercase hex/address:u64/generation:nonzero u64/domain:data|code
exact_fields.origins: sorted distinct bit-index records; exact fields bit:u32/pointer:registry identity/source_bit:u32<64

constraints: origin bit agrees with admitted pointer address bit
origin and poison do not overlap
same complete pointer and source-bit order0..63 required for pointer provenance restoration

operations.slice: preserve selected bit/poison/origin; low bit has offset zero
operations.concat: first part lowest-address bits; preserve ordered shadow
operations.freeze: each poison bit chooses zero; retain concrete bits/origins
operations.bitcast_integer_or_float: any poison bit -> whole scalar poison; otherwise strip provenance without exposing it
operations.bitcast_pointer: any poison bit -> poison; full correctly ordered same pointer -> original pointer; otherwise address with no provenance
operations.linear_memory: byte-sized raw load/store/memmove only; all bounds checked before mutation; initial bits poison; memmove snapshot includes shadow

limits: sequential memory <=8191 bytes; no guest lifetime/concurrency/atomicity or nonbyte memory contract
